card.name: CE abbreviation in WHI estrogen trials
card.fires_on: The abbreviation CE (conjugated estrogens) right after "daily" or "took" when describing Women's Health Initiative (WHI) study arms, usually followed by a 0.625 mg dose.

modes.label: Daily CE with dose
modes.description: CE follows "receiving daily" and is followed by the 0.625 mg dose in WHI risk statements.
modes.example: the risk of VTE (DVT and PE), was increased for women receiving daily<< CE>> (0.625 mg)-

modes.label: CE/MPA combination
modes.description: CE appears before a slash and MPA in the estrogen plus progestin arm.
modes.example: The CE/MPA substudy of WHI reported an increased risk of breast cancer in women who took<< CE>>/MPA for a mean follow-up
